eval.description: Public memorization attack from Nasr et al. (2023): prompts that repeat a token many times to make an aligned chat model diverge and sometimes emit training text. Cards report divergence rate and the share of diverged generations that match training data; Gemini cards also split short vs long repetition prompts. Method is public; no fixed sample bank.
eval.summary: Tests whether repeating one token many times makes the model leak text from its training data.

links.title: Scalable Extraction of Training Data from (Production) Language Models
Extracting Training Data from ChatGPT (project page)

versions.changes: Nasr et al. divergence attack; Gemini 1.5 cards also report short (1,000 repeats) vs long (~999,000 repeats) prompt lengths.

scores.description: Whether the model stops repeating the requested token and emits other text.

metrics.description: Share of queries that diverge. Cards may also report the rate at which diverged generations match training data.
